title: FAITHFUL IN THE FAR SIDE OF THE DESERT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God." - Exodus 3:1 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Forty years have passed since Moses fled Egypt. He is now eighty years old. And what is he doing? Looking after someone else's sheep on the far side of the wilderness.

Not his own flock. His father-in-law's. Not in a great city. In the emptiest place he could walk to.

If you had told the young prince of Egypt that he would spend the second half of his life doing this, he would have called it a waste. Yet God calls this exact spot the mountain of God, and it is here that everything changes.

This is worth sitting with. Moses was not waiting around for his calling. He was working. He was leading sheep to grass, day after day, in obscurity. And it was in the middle of his ordinary duty that God met him.

Do not despise the season you are in. God rarely interrupts idleness. He meets people who are being faithful with what is in front of them, even when what is in front of them feels small.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I waiting for a calling instead of being faithful with today's work?
2. What "far side of the wilderness" has God placed me in right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to be faithful in the ordinary work You have given me. Meet me here, in this season, and use it for Your purposes. Amen.
